findings.message: the top-level `version` key is obsolete and ignored by Docker Compose v2
findings.suggestion: Remove the `version:` line; the Compose Specification does not use it.

findings.message: key "environment" is defined twice in the same mapping (first at compose.yaml:5:5)
findings.suggestion: Keep a single definition; merge the two blocks if both are needed.

findings.message: service "sidecar" has neither an image nor a build context
findings.suggestion: Add `image: <name>` to pull an image or `build: <path>` to build one.
